item.text: {"kind":"final","payload_json":"{\"status\":\"completed\",\"content\":{\"selected_proposal\":{\"name\":\"Sensitivity-Regularized Summary Alignment (SRSA)\",\"idea\":\"Prepare a finite, label-free source summary at one chosen internal representation h of dimension d, then use unlabeled target batches to fit a small affine adapter h'=Ah+b while freezing the original deterministic scalar regressor. The adapter matches target representation moments to retained source moments, but a source-derived output-sensitivity metric penalizes transformations likely to disturb task-relevant directions. If reliability diagnostics fail, deployment uses the unchanged predictor.\",\"source_preparation\":\"With temporary access to source examples and the frozen model, retain the example count, representation mean mu_s, covariance C_s, and G_s=E_s[(gradient_h f)(gradient_h f)^T]. Also retain finite quantiles of moment-estimation variability obtained by source resampling for diagnostic thresholds. No source example, source label, or per-example feature is retained.\",\"deployment_rule\":\"For a sufficiently coherent target batch, estimate mu_t and C_t and minimize a regularized objective consisting of mean mismatch, covariance mismatch, and a G_s-weighted penalty for deviation from the identity transform. Use shrinkage and a diagonal or low-rank parameterization when d is large. Apply the resulting adapter before the frozen downstream network. Revert to A=I,b=0 when the batch is too small, covariance is ill-conditioned, the shift is dominated by highly sensitive directions, or discrepancies exceed the source-derived reliability range.\",\"information_and_storage\":\"Deployment requires only unlabeled target inputs, forward passes, and the retained aggregate summary. A full-matrix summary stores O(d^2) numbers: d means, d(d+1)/2 covariance entries, d(d+1)/2 sensitivity entries, plus counts, thresholds, and regularization metadata. A documented rank-r version requires O(dr+r^2) storage. Preparation requires source inputs and model gradients but no labels; deployment retains neither source nor target examples after batch processing.\"},\"mechanism_and_assumptions\":{\"mechanism\":\"Moment restoration supplies a measurable signal even though the regressor has no predictive distribution. C_s identifies the source representation manifold, while G_s distinguishes movements that locally change the scalar output from movements that are comparatively output-insensitive. Their combination aims to remove off-manifold covariate perturbations without treating every feature direction as equally safe to align. Identity fallback makes 'leave unchanged' an explicit outcome rather than assuming every detected shift warrants adaptation.\",\"assumptions\":[\"A selected internal representation admits an approximately affine, moment-visible description of an important part of the shift.\",\"The source regression relationship remains valid after correcting that representation; substantial concept or conditional shift is outside the method's information capacity.\",\"Source output gradients are a useful local proxy for task relevance, despite not being labels or a guarantee of target correctness.\",\"The target batch is large and homogeneous enough to estimate the retained statistics; mixed or rapidly changing streams require segmentation or no adaptation.\",\"The downstream network behaves regularly near the source representation region, so a source-local sensitivity penalty has relevance after shift.\"],\"measurable_failure_indicators\":[\"Large standardized discrepancies concentrated in high-eigenvalue directions of G_s.\",\"Poor target covariance conditioning or uncertainty beyond retained source-resampling thresholds.\",\"A large required affine displacement or unstable solutions across target subsamples.\",\"No reduction in held-out target-batch moment discrepancy, in which case the adapter is rejected.\"],\"non_identifiability\":\"Unlabeled covariates cannot reveal whether P(y|x) changed. Consequently, SRSA cannot certify improved target regression error; its diagnostics can reject unsupported adaptation but cannot prove target correctness.\"},\"difference_and_feasibility\":{\"substantive_difference\":\"Within the eight-paper library, this is not entropy minimization, because the deterministic scalar output is not converted into an invented probability distribution (doc-2006.10726v1, pp. 2-3). It does not require a jointly trained auxiliary task as in test-time training (doc-1909.13231v1, pp. 2-3), class probabilities or class-diversity objectives as in SHOT (doc-2002.08546v1, pp. 3-4), or target replacement of batch-normalization statistics without task-direction protection (doc-2006.16971v1, pp. 2-3; doc-1502.03167v1, pp. 3-4). It shares moment-alignment ancestry with Deep CORAL but replaces deployment-time source examples with an explicitly documented finite summary and adds regression-output sensitivity regularization plus an identity fallback (doc-1607.01719v1, pp. 2-3). This is a meaningful difference within the bounded library, not a claim of global novelty.\",\"feasibility\":\"All required deployment quantities are available from the frozen model, a finite source summary, and unlabeled target inputs. The adapter is small and can be optimized on CPU or obtained through restricted diagonal/low-rank moment transforms. Evaluation would require target labels held back from adaptation, but labels are not required by the deployed method. No implementation or experiment was executed because the task requests a research idea and provides no execution facility.\",\"material_risks\":[\"Matching marginal moments can erase useful target structure or align distributions while worsening regression error.\",\"Average source gradients may miss nonlinear, interaction-dependent, or target-emergent sensitivity.\",\"Moment summaries may be inadequate for multimodal representations.\",\"Diagnostic fallback improves conservatism but may reject shifts that could have been corrected.\"],\"evidence_boundary\":\"The reviewed library establishes relevant precedents and access-condition differences, but it neither demonstrates SRSA nor exhausts regression adaptation research through the 2024-09-01 cutoff.\"},\"core_hypotheses_with_conditions_comparators_and_challenging_evidence\":[{\"type\":\"performance\",\"claim\":\"Under covariate shifts that perturb moment-visible representation geometry while preserving the source regression relationship, SRSA lowers target mean squared error relative to the frozen model.\",\"conditions\":\"Target batches are sufficiently large and coherent; the chosen layer exposes the perturbation; diagnostics accept adaptation; there is no material concept shift.\",\"comparators\":[\"Frozen predictor\",\"Target-statistics replacement analogous to batch-normalization adaptation\",\"Ungated source-summary mean/covariance alignment\"],\"challenging_evidence\":\"No improvement or worse error across multiple qualifying shifts; gains limited to a single corruption; or improvement disappearing when adapter capacity and target access are matched.\"},{\"type\":\"contribution\",\"claim\":\"The sensitivity term contributes beyond generic moment matching by reducing harmful output changes while retaining useful correction.\",\"conditions\":\"The representation contains both task-sensitive and less-sensitive directions, and G_s estimates their local distinction adequately.\",\"comparators\":[\"Same affine adapter with sensitivity weight set to zero\",\"Identity adapter\",\"Isotropic displacement regularization with matched strength\"],\"predictions\":\"Compared with ungated alignment, SRSA should have fewer catastrophic error increases and smaller source-function drift for a comparable reduction in target moment discrepancy.\",\"challenging_evidence\":\"The zero-weight or isotropic variants match or dominate both target error and failure rate, G_s eigenspaces are unstable across source resamples, or sensitivity weighting merely forces the identity.\"},{\"type\":\"mechanism\",\"claim\":\"Benefits, when present, arise from returning target representations toward the source-supported region without excessive movement along output-sensitive directions, rather than from moment matching alone.\",\"conditions\":\"Controlled shifts or evaluation data permit measurement of representation displacement and target error without exposing labels to adaptation.\",\"comparators\":[\"Accepted SRSA transformations\",\"Moment-matched transformations deliberately rotated relative to G_s\",\"Transformations with similar parameter norm but poor source-moment restoration\"],\"predictions\":\"Error improvement should covary with restored source-manifold diagnostics after controlling for transform magnitude, while high G_s-weighted displacement should predict failures.\",\"challenging_evidence\":\"Target error is unrelated to either restoration or sensitivity-weighted displacement, or rotated/placebo transformations perform equivalently.\"},{\"type\":\"safety_and_scope\",\"claim\":\"The diagnostic gate makes SRSA approximately neutral more often than always-adapt baselines when evidence is unreliable, but it cannot detect all conditional shifts.\",\"conditions\":\"Small, mixed, ill-conditioned, or high-sensitivity target batches represented among evaluations; thresholds fixed using source preparation only.\",\"comparators\":[\"Always apply SRSA\",\"Always apply ungated moment alignment\",\"Never adapt\"],\"predictions\":\"The gate should reduce severe regressions relative to always-adapt rules while applying the identity on rejected batches.\",\"challenging_evidence\":\"Rejected batches would consistently benefit, accepted batches frequently suffer large errors, or gate decisions are unstable under target subsampling.\"}]},\"artifacts\":[],\"omissions\":[\"No experiment, implementation, numerical result, or performance guarantee was produced.\",\"No claim of global novelty or exhaustive literature coverage is made because evidence is restricted to eight pinned papers.\",\"Exact layer, rank, regularization weights, batch size, and diagnostic thresholds remain empirical design choices to be fixed before evaluation.\"]}"}
